confidence_notes: I ran one search for the RBA rate and four for Jaipur prices. These covered restaurant meals, coffee, beer, and cocktails and wine. Sources were mostly crowd-sourced or aggregator figures (Expatistan-style pub and club prices, a European coffee index, EazyDiner cost-for-two listings, hotel bar menus). Many were undated or from 2023-2024, so the anchors are bounded estimates, not verified current averages. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are fairly well supported. Beer is moderately supported: sources ranged from about INR 250 for a neighbourhood pub to INR 449 on a hotel menu, and I used a typical mid-range restaurant level. Cocktail and wine are weaker. Cocktail rests on one older club-price figure plus local price relationships to beer. Wine rests on hotel menu prices of about INR 1,000-1,500 per glass or serve, which I discounted to a typical restaurant level for Indian wine by the glass. I did not search accommodation prices. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Jaipur's budget, hostel and mid-range hotel market, with no live listings inspected, so they carry the most uncertainty. Local-currency conversions used an approximate INR/USD rate of about 88-90 and are rough.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jaipur is treated as a major Indian tourist city with prices similar to Agra and Udaipur and a little below Delhi. Restaurant and drink prices are scaled from Indian city-level price indexes. Cocktail and wine prices follow the usual Indian bar markup over beer.
